sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
Caliban, Dante's Titan is the biggest, deadliest [[Titan]] at the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik Foundation's]] disposal! His 8 ATK means that he has enough attack power to take down virtually anything, and his 6 DEF makes him incredibly hard to defeat. Use Caliban's discard cost to your advantage by either discarding extra copies of it or playing heroes that benefit from your discards. Caliban is a natural partner for [[TCG:SAS-013|Metagolem, Icon of History]], since Metagolem has huge ATK but can't be played if you have other cards in your hand.
